text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Pheww, alright!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Buena-san, what an astonishing number of times...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to fall behind either—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...198, 199, 200—
Hehe. An ordeal of this level is nothing—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Wh—!
You were still doing that...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...No. As expected of you, Buena.
I shall gladly take on that challenge!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
498, 499, 500...
—Wait, squats are next!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Next is core training...!?
Urgh... A trial like this is nothing...!!
I'm... not done yet...!!

It was almost time for training with Desire.
As I waited for her to arrive—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—...I-I'm sorry.
Um... did I keep you waiting...?
choice_data_list: Are you okay? ...You tired or anything?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! I just went a bit overboard
with my independent training—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Still, there is no problem at all!
Now, let us begin, Trainer."

Still, I can't let her overdo it.
Just as I was about to rethink the training routine—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Phew......... *pant*.
I know I can still do more...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...One more rep—no, two more!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Taaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Running even more laps
after that brutal workout...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer.
Please give me the exact same menu as Buena-san!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No, not a problem at all.
...Please, go ahead!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...*pant*... *gasp*...
Even though I haven't even run... half of it yet..."
choice_data_list: You really should call it a day today.

text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for training.
I hope what went wrong yesterday
isn't weighing heavily on her mind—
choice_data_list: I wonder if Desire is okay...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you again today!
choice_data_list: ...Desire! Wait, why are you in your racing gear?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"This is...
Yes, for I must surpass who I was yesterday."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I went to the gym just a little while ago.
I even increased my training load compared to yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Now, preparations are complete! Let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely!
I haven't been able to calm down since last night!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Dietary methods to boost stamina.
...Pacing strategies for athletes.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I need to gather more information! Otherwise,
I'll never overcome this immense trial...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
……I can't surpass it?
Me……?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Who is the one who has overcome
so many trials up until now?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That's right, I am Red Desire...!
Even when my times weren't great, even when I wasn't acknowledged, I've overcome it all...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No matter how bitter or painful it may be,
if it is a trial, I will surely overcome it!
Because I am—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Because she is a Saint...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Did you know, Trainer?
Red is a color that wards off evil.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What is that demon—the greatest demon of all...?
Having listened this far, perhaps you've already realized?
The greatest demon... is one's own weak self. To exorcise such a demon, she has donned her crimson racing silks.
choice_data_list: Of course. ...That's why I believe in you, too.
Of course. ...That's why I believe in you, too.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Let's be on our way, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: A trial of this degree, I shall blow it right away!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ......*pant*, *pant*.
And so, she powered through twice her usual training regimen, and at a much faster pace.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What do you think...!
I believe I gave it my absolute all...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What do you think...!
I believe I gave it my absolute all...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
There is no trial I cannot overcome.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What shall we do next?
...You are more than welcome to bestow further trials upon me, you know?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am a saintly maiden.
I am someone who will overcome any trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Still, somehow... hehehe.
